training.title: Incompany Training
training.description: We teach teams in any department to build their own AI products. From zero to hero in two weeks, inside your company.
training.heroHeading: What used to wait on IT now starts in <u>your team.</u>
training.heroLead: In two weeks the department ships a live module. AI in the process, human intelligence in command.
training.heroCta: I want this for my team

sectors.label: any sector of the company gains autonomy

queue.label: no queues to launch your products

training.learnHeading: The request stays. Who <u>builds</u> it changes.
training.learnLead: Today a good idea crosses the whole company and waits in line. With the Incompany training, it is born and goes live inside the sector itself.
training.normalTitle: One idea, one queue, one product that arrives late.
normalSteps: Sends it to the team that will build it
That team receives it and opens a ticket
The ticket joins a priority queue
You lose visibility, and the dev team sets the priority
Often, it is no longer needed
training.pivotTitle: That is where Matilha comes in.
training.pivotBody: We cut the queue: the lab moves inside your sector.
training.matilhaTitle: The idea is born and goes live in the sector itself.
matilhaSteps: Applies what it learned in the training
In 2 weeks, the product is live
training.matilhaResultValue: the 1st product. The team keeps building the next ones.
training.pathsClosing: This happens because the team is trained with our <u>Incompany training</u>: skilled and ready to solve endless problems without leaving the department.
training.shiftHeading: Before: one queue. Now each department builds its own module.
training.beforeBody: A request to IT. A marketing queue. A brief that waits. Internal product lived on the other side of the building.
training.afterBody: Each team gains the craft to create. Legal builds its own. Compliance builds its own. Engineering builds its own. The company stops depending on a single queue.
training.whoHeading: From startup to large enterprise: applied AI that drives results.
training.whoLead: A training for teams that want to turn ideas into real solutions, gain speed and apply artificial intelligence with autonomy.
training.whoStartupsBody: Equip your team to validate ideas, build solutions and automate processes with AI from day one. All with more agility and less technical dependence.
training.whoEnterpriseBody: Prepare entire areas and teams to apply AI day to day, build internal solutions and meet business demands with security, autonomy and efficiency.
training.modulesHeading: From the first product to a system that talks to the company.
training.basicBody: Incompany, hands on. The team leaves zero and ships a real internal product: idea, flow, interface and an AI application that solves a live problem in the department.
basicItems: Discovery of the problem in the team's own context
An AI application ready to use
A team ready to build the next module
training.advancedBody: For teams already building who need to go beyond the prototype. Services with databases, name recognition and language intent. The product starts to understand what people ask for and to keep what the company already knows.
advancedItems: Modules that talk to each other
training.method1Body: We go to the team. The lab is the real context, not a generic course.
training.method2Body: Not slides. A live application in the hands of the people who will use it.
training.method3Body: Each department gains the craft to continue alone. Matilha starts it. The team keeps going.
training.timelineHeading: The team arrives without a product. It leaves with one live.
training.timelineLead: An incompany lab, a real problem, a working application at the end. Then teams already building go deeper into language and data.

steps.title: Immersion in the department
steps.body: The real problem, in the real context. Legal, operations, marketing: the lab is the team itself.

steps.title: Designing the module
steps.body: Flow, experience and what the AI will do. The team defines the product it will build.

steps.title: Hands on
steps.body: The application takes shape. Interface, intelligence and a flow that solves the daily demand.

steps.title: Product in their hands
steps.body: Not slides. A live tool, used by the people who asked for it. The team already has the range for the next module.

steps.title: Language and data
steps.body: Teams already building go further: databases, names, entities and language intent. The product starts talking to the company.

training.ctaHeading: Which department in your company is still waiting in line?
training.ctaBody: Tell us the problem. We assemble the right module for your team.
training.ctaFormulaOut: as many products as you need
training.ctaFormulaNote: The capability stays in the department. The next module does not have to cross the building.
